title: Missed Approvals Fix
eyebrow: Design for approval · house-rules plugin, the design-loop lock · nothing built yet

short.lead: Your two approvals for the QA evidence by change type feature never reached the code lock (the check that refuses code edits until you approve a stage). The lock reads each of your messages from the folder the session is in when the message arrives. In these cloud sessions that folder is /home/claude, which holds the cloned repos but is not a repo itself, so the lock found no stage file and quietly did nothing. So the lock still treats the last feature, proof check fix, as done, and refuses every code edit. This design makes the lock find the repo, and makes it say so out loud when it can't.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it changes and what it needs from you.
items: Found in the lock's own code

When a message arrives, scripts/house_rules/design_loop.py (_loop_scope_note) looks for a git repo (a project folder tracked by git) starting at the message's folder and walking up through the folders above it (core.py, _issues_locate).
From /home/claude it walks up to / and finds no repo, so it gives up without a result: no stage moves, and no note says why.

The part of the lock that refuses edits starts from the edited file's own location, so it does find the repo and refuses. The part that reads your messages can't find it, so the two halves of the lock disagree.
Look one level down, and never stay silent

When the message's folder isn't inside a repo, the lock also checks the folders directly inside it (where cloud sessions clone repos). If exactly one has a design-loop stage file, the message goes to that repo. If two or more do, nothing moves and the note names them, because one approval must never start the same feature in two repos.
When it still finds none, and the message holds an approval phrase, it says so in a note naming the folder it searched, instead of returning nothing.
The fix edits the lock that refuses edits

The lock refuses this fix for the same reason it refused the QA work. The only clean way through is your permission to build this one fix with the lock switched off (HOUSE_RULES_LOOP=off), for the fix's edits only. Every other check stays on.
Your answer to the second choice under Choices (how this fix gets past the lock).

Once the fix is merged and the plugin is updated here, you send "Design approved: QA evidence by change type 1A 2A 3A" and "Build plan approved: QA evidence by change type" again, and the lock records them.
Two short messages, after I tell you the fix is in.

changes: Finding the repo for a message (scripts/house_rules/design_loop.py)
Only the message's folder and the folders above it are searched.
When those hold no repo, the folders directly inside the message's folder are searched too. The one repo there with a stage file gets the message; two or more get nothing and a note naming them.
A repo with no stage file is skipped, so a folder of unrelated cloned repos moves nothing.
No repo found: no note at all.
No repo found and the message holds an approval phrase: a note naming the folder searched and saying nothing moved.
This follows the house rule that nothing fails silently.

A design approval sent from a folder that holds one repo with a stage file one level down moves that repo's stage. Two such repos move nothing and get a note naming both. A folder with no repo anywhere gets the note naming the folder searched.
choices: When the message's folder isn't a repo, which repos get the message?
The one folder directly inside it that has a stage file
Matches how cloud sessions lay out their clones. A repo with no stage file is left alone, and two repos with stage files get a note instead of a guess.
Only the repo the session last edited a file in
Needs a new record of which repo was edited last, and a session's first message would still be missed, because nothing has been edited yet.
Both of your missed approvals arrived while the session sat in /home/claude, with the plugin repo cloned at /home/claude/ajsclaudecodetools.
How does this one fix get past the lock?
You allow HOUSE_RULES_LOOP=off for this fix's edits only
The lock is off only while I edit and test these files; the commit and push checks stay on.
You edit the stage file by hand
Works, but it puts the work in your hands, which the house rules try to avoid.
The fix edits the very code that refuses edits, so it can't approve itself.

wrapup.summary: Make the code lock find the repo when a message arrives from the folder above it, and say out loud when it finds nothing.
wrapup.changing: scripts/house_rules/design_loop.py, scripts/checks/design_loop.py, and the plugin version.
wrapup.blocking: Your approval of this design, and your answers to the two choices under Choices.
